`test_sync_env_from_config_creates_env_from_example` (`tests/unit/test_ops.py:1412`) still has `monkeypatch.setattr(ops, "REPO_ROOT", tmp_path)`, which is now a no-op leftover from before this PR's `env_path.parent`-relative resolution — harmless but worth cleaning up since it no longer does anything.

Not a blocker, just noting it was deliberately reviewed and not overlooked.

`_is_open`'s `RESOLVE_ANOMALY` check treats any OWNER `RESOLVE_ANOMALY` comment as closing every marker that precedes it, regardless of which step it was for. This appears intentional (a single global "all clear" keyword) rather than a bug, but is worth the owner's awareness if multiple distinct anomalies are ever open concurrently.
